newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah firms, focus on liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah firms, focus on liquidity.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah firmed against the dollar in moderate early trading on Friday, with the focus on liquidity, dealers said.
They said trading was slightly higher than previous days but remained slow, with the market concerned over possible rupiah tightening in the afternoon on weekly tax payments.
One Japanese bank dealer said his main concern for the day was liquidity although overnight money had eased to 11.0 percent from 14.0 percent at the opening.
Dealers said the relatively ample supply in early trading softened short-dated swaps and helped ease longer-term swaps.
Overnight swaps slid to 1.0 from 1.5 points. Tom/next swaps were at 0.25/0.30 points.
Dealers said liquidity concerns seemed to strengthen the rupiah, lifting it through the 2,427.0 resistance level to 2,426.25 briefly before settling at 2,427.5/28.0 at 0300 GMT.
Spot rupiah opened at 2,426.75/27.75. Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,427.00/27.75 and 2,426.0/26.5, respectively.
One U.S. bank dealer said offshore operators continued to hold long rupiah in the forward market, but reduced some positions when they took profits from the relatively ample market.
"But I think they still tend to remain long in forwards," the dealer said, adding the market was still vulnerable to spillover from rumours of swap restrictions in other centres.
One-month swaps softened slightly to 12.25/13.25 from 12.50/13.50, two to 26.50/27.50 from 27.0/28.0, three to 38.0/39.0 and six to 78.5/80.0 from 80.0/82.0 points.
The central bank raised its intervention band by one point to 2,421/2,613 and its conversion band also by one point to 2,421/2,469 on Thursday. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
